entities.summary: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is a sovereign nation in Caribbean, Americas. Its capital is Kingstown. Official languages include English. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy (Commonwealth realm). Population: approximately 0.1 million. Area: 389 km². Comprehensive index for Saint Vincent and the Grenadines covering Ciboney/Arawak/Kalinago indigenous peoples, fierce Kalinago resistance (British struggled to colonize), Black Caribs/Garifuna formation (escaped African slaves + Kalinago), First/Second Carib Wars (1769-73, 1795-97), Garifuna deportation to Honduras 1797, French-British rivalry, sugar/slavery economy, emancipation 1834, independence 1979, La Soufrière volcano eruptions (1902 killed 1,600; 1979 evacuation; 2021 eruption), and multi-island nation.
